sloka: पाणिभ्याम् च कुचौ काचित् सुवर्ण कलश उपमौ ।उपगूह्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता ॥५-१०-४७॥
transliteration: pāṇibhyām ca kucau kācit suvarṇa kalaśa upamau ।upagūhya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā ॥5-10-47॥

translations.english: Overcome with sleep another woman lay pressing with her own hands her golden gobletlike breasts.
